about.html:
{app_name}

Version: {version}

Built with: PySide6 (Qt for Python)

Database: SQLite


A simple budget manager for:

  • Budget planning by category
  • Tracking income and expenses
  • Visualization and analysis
  • Savings goals and favorites
  • Tags and budget warnings

Highlights {app_version}:

  • Hardened portable updater
  • Stable Windows/Linux launch files in the portable ZIP
  • Account hub and selectable data folder
  • Budget, tracking and i18n hardening

mode.label: Forecast mode
mode.tooltip: Controls budget suggestions: Auto treats “fixed but not recurring” as a pot and “fixed/recurring” as incremental. Pot = one reserve per period; incremental = irregular annual/partial payments with zero-month protection.

help.budget_pot: Budget pot: a category's monthly budgets are treated as one shared pot across the year. An expensive month is fine as long as the pot lasts overall (typical for deductibles, clothing, gifts).
help.month_close: The month-end close calculates: income minus expenses minus savings. You can book a surplus into savings; a deficit can be covered from savings with funds. Fixed costs are never suggested for cuts.
help.savings: Savings are money you set aside: it leaves the freely available pot but is not gone. Withdrawals are negative savings bookings.

tip.due_day: Due day = preferred booking day in the month. Book fixed/recurring uses this day; if the month is shorter, the app uses the last valid day of the month.
tip.fixcost: Fixed cost = fixed, recurring amount. Taken automatically from the budget when using ‘Book fixed costs’ (budget 0 = skipped) and protected from zero-month reductions in budget suggestions. See Help → Handbook.
tip.recurring: Recurring = regular booking with a target day. When booking, the app checks whether the month is already recorded; the amount can be adjusted in the list. See Help → Handbook.

For a deficit, savings are suggested first and then flexible expenses; fixed costs, pots/reserves and incremental annual costs stay protected.

setup.budget_explain_body:
6.1 Edit categories
• Right-click a row (or ⚙/dialog) → rename, delete, set flags.

6.2 Set budget
• Enter amounts directly in the month columns in the selected currency.
• The total is calculated automatically.

6.3 Table explained
• Column ⭐ Fixed: mark fixed costs (e.g. rent).
• Column ∞ Recurring: recurring booking (e.g. monthly subscription).
• Column Day: due day of the month (1–31).

setup.setup_mode_intro:
Glad you're here! You'll be ready in a few minutes.

Express setup (button below): create default categories, enable learning mode – just start booking, budgets come automatically later. Ideal to get going right now.

Guided setup (checkbox below): we walk through categories, budget and the first booking step by step.

Tip: press Enter to jump to the next page anytime. You'll find the assistant again under Help → Getting started.
setup.tracking_entry_missing: <small>Please record at least one transaction to continue.</small>

In Tracking (bookings) you record real payments.

setup.tracking_fix_desc:
8.1 Book fixed/recurring
The Book fixed/recurring… button creates bookings from categories marked as ⭐ fixed costs or ∞ recurring.

What happens?
• A list is prepared.
• Fixed costs take the amount from the budget (if > 0).
• Recurring items (without a fixed amount) can be adjusted in the dialog.

status.month_tooltip: Traffic-light rating of the month: green = on track. Yellow = expenses at 90% of budget or free remainder below 5% of income. Red = budget exceeded or more spent (incl. savings) than earned.
status.salary_cycle_tooltip: Monthly status for {period}. The {budget_month} {budget_year} budget is used for comparison. The cycle starts with the actual salary receipt near the configured salary day; without a matching booking it starts on the configured day.

suggestion.chronic_text: These categories should definitely be adjusted.
suggestion.suggestion_deficit: {typ} – {cat}: For {n} months averaging {amount} over budget. Suggestion: Increase budget from {current} to {suggested}.
suggestion.suggestion_surplus: {typ} – {cat}: For {n} months averaging {amount} under budget. Suggestion: Reduce budget from {current} to {suggested}.
suggestion.suggestion_tracking_projection: {typ} – {cat}: Projection from {n} active / {months} observed months without a yearly budget. Detected as: {kind}. Tracking: {tracking}. Suggestion: Set budget to {suggested}.
suggestion.suggestion_tracking_stable: {typ} – {cat}: Stable learned suggestion from {n} active / {months} observed months without a yearly budget. Detected as: {kind}. Tracking: {tracking}. Suggestion: Set budget to {suggested}.
suggestion.why_deficit: Why? Over the last {n} months, spending averaged {amount} ABOVE budget. Applying raises the budget from {current} to {suggested}.
suggestion.why_learning: Why? {n} tracked months without a yearly budget, typical monthly value {amount}. Applying creates a NEW budget of {suggested} (budget kind is confirmed in the process).
suggestion.why_surplus: Why? Over the last {n} months, an average of {amount} of the budget was left over. Applying lowers the budget from {current} to {suggested}.
